compatibility: Authentic schema17 unfinished autonomous drinking and earlier schema fixtures load through normal checksummed migration. Old saves retain supplies, actor identities and previously open routes. New-game reset is separately validated for all three rosters.
validation_scope: The clean imported project ran 2164 logical checks, 607 previous GUI checks and 55 previous persistence processes.

Only compact_hud.gd changed afterward to expose participant cards during defense; 31 actual GUI checks then verified visible cards, no toolbar overlap and mouse takeover. Tactical, siege, self-care and campaign unit suites were repeated against the final export project. Other 68 runtime input hashes remain identical.

Nine actual balance runs use normal resource-paid commands: six 35-day strategies, three 60-day endless continuations. No actor stats, enemies, positions, stocks or mission progress are injected. Three different personal arcs complete through real reconnaissance and paid work.

Final ordinary Linux bytes completed real OS keyboard/search/T return/explicit exit/native close/restart on a cold X server. Final separate QA bytes completed the desktop matrix, fullscreen and six minutes of rendered continuous play, then actual close and restart.

The desktop QA pilot uses a shorter 70-second minimum daytime decision policy to cover a real expedition within the short smoke run; accelerated long-run simulation uses the original 190-second policy. These are separate from the unmodified ordinary game input path.
Graphical room checks explicitly clear enemies and position the player to isolate interaction; the defense display uses a declared third-night time and seed. These are not counted as balance runs.

The historical core-scene three-person long-run policy had known failures reproduced on v1.9 and v1.10; it is retained behind --legacy-prototype-long-runs, not counted as passing and not used to represent the current campaign.
fixed_issues: Initial raid wave now respects preparation time.
Unarmed pushes cannot displace an enemy sideways off stairs.
Guard interception of climbing enemies targets real landings.
Reset snapshot includes campaign stack flags before validation.
Shared door/window input latch permits changing interaction key without double toggles.
Raid participants remain visible and selectable without overlapping combat controls.
limitations: Windows officially exported, not tested on Windows hardware.
Audible sound was not verified; automated graphical checks use Dummy audio.
Desktop continuous verification covers six minutes, not the default thirty-minute Windows run.
Sixty simulated days across three starts and one default seed is finite evidence, not proof of all strategies, seeds or infinite survival.
Enemy minds are finite behavior rules and remembered sensory events, not general intelligence; infection stories are static authored records, not human dialogue NPCs.
